name: NotebookLM
one_liner: AI tool that generates insights and summaries from the user's uploaded documents and sources.
auth_notes: OAuth 2.0 bearer token required; API keys are not accepted. Personal Google Account during Public Preview; Workspace accounts fail with 403.
access_notes: Personal API path: enable notebook.googleapis.com in own Cloud project, configure OAuth consent screen, create OAuth client, and sign in to Gemini Notebook once. Public Preview, personal accounts only. Enterprise REST API needs a Gemini Notebook Enterprise license. Cost of the personal API not stated on the pages.

buildability.rationale: Personal OAuth API is in Public Preview and limited to personal Google Accounts; enterprise REST API requires a paid Gemini Notebook Enterprise license.

identity.quote: Gemini Notebook Enterprise is a powerful tool for generating insights and summaries from your documents.

auth.quote: The Gemini Notebook API uses OAuth 2.0 to authenticate requests on behalf of a Google user.
The API doesn't accept API keys.

access.quote: During the Public Preview, the Gemini Notebook API is only available for personal Google Accounts.
The projects.locations.notebooks REST API methods on this page require an authenticated user account with an active Gemini Notebook Enterprise license.

api_surface.quote: Read and write access to notebooks and sources

buildability.quote: During the Public Preview, the Gemini Notebook API is only available for personal Google Accounts.

needs_human_reason: Pages do not state cost or waitlist for the personal Public Preview API, and do not say whether the preview is GA. Confirm access and pricing, and whether the consumer app is distinct from the Enterprise API.
